resources.title: Class E Knowledge Exam & Driving Skills Test

intro: Florida's Class E Knowledge Exam has 50 multiple-choice questions on traffic laws, safe driving practices and traffic controls. You need 40 correct (80%) to pass.

testTypes.name: Regular driver (Class E)
testTypes.description: Florida's practice question bank is being verified against the official handbook.

notes: You must pass the Class E Knowledge Exam to obtain a learner's license.
Applicants under 18 can take the Class E Knowledge Exam online through a registered third-party administrator.

source.title: FLHSMV — Class E Knowledge Exam & Driving Skills Test

faq.q: How many questions are on the Florida Class E Knowledge Exam?
faq.a: 50 multiple-choice questions about Florida traffic laws, safe driving practices and identifying traffic controls. You must answer 40 correctly (80%).

faq.q: Can I take the Florida knowledge exam online?
faq.a: Applicants under 18 can take the Class E Knowledge Exam online through a registered third-party administrator.
